video.needsBody: ZeroConverter converts video with FFmpeg, which is downloaded once ({{size}}) from {{host}}, checked against a fixed checksum and kept in the app's data folder. Everything else keeps working offline.

quick.gone: This conversion is no longer waiting.
quick.largeFile: This file is {{size}}. Converting it can take a while and fill a lot of disk space.

settings.title: Settings
settings.renameDesc: Rename a file in File Explorer to another format, like {{from}} to {{to}}, and it is converted. The original goes to the Recycle Bin. Rename a folder to {{folder}} and every picture in it converts.
settings.renameDescKeep: Rename a file in File Explorer to another format, like {{from}} to {{to}}, and it is converted. The original stays next to the new file. Rename a folder to {{folder}} and every picture in it converts.
settings.keepOriginalDesc: Originals stay next to the new file instead of going to the Recycle Bin.
settings.suffixKeep: Keep the original next to the new file
settings.suffixRecycle: Send the original to the Recycle Bin
settings.foldersDesc: Renames made in File Explorer convert on any local drive. In these folders, renames from other apps convert too. Engine and build folders such as Library, Intermediate and node_modules are always left alone.
settings.contextDesc: Adds Convert with ZeroConverter to File Explorer's menu. The original stays. On Windows 11 it is under Show more options.
settings.autostartDesc: ZeroConverter waits in the system tray so renames convert right away.
settings.languageDesc: System follows the display language of Windows.
settings.videoIntro: Video, and audio taken from a video, is converted with FFmpeg. Pictures and audio files do not need it. An FFmpeg already installed on this computer is used when it has everything ZeroConverter needs.
settings.ffmpegSystem: Using the FFmpeg already on this computer{{path}}.
settings.ffmpegManaged: Downloaded by ZeroConverter and kept in its data folder.
settings.ffmpegMissingInstall: Not installed. Downloads once ({{size}}) from {{host}}, checked against a fixed checksum. {{license}}.
settings.ffmpegMissing: Not installed. Install FFmpeg and put it on PATH, then restart ZeroConverter.
settings.motionDesc: Follow system uses the motion setting of this computer.
settings.themeNote: System switches between {{dark}} and {{light}} with Windows.
settings.notifyDesc: A card in the corner of the screen when a conversion finishes or fails.
settings.soundDesc: Plays when a conversion finishes. Errors stay silent.
settings.aboutBody: Converts images, textures, HDR and audio on this computer, on every CPU core. Nothing is uploaded.
settings.aboutLicense: Open source under the MIT license. MP3 encoding uses LAME, under the GNU LGPL; the interface fonts Inter, JetBrains Mono and Space Grotesk are under the SIL Open Font License. Their notices and license texts are in the licenses folder next to the program.
settings.updateAvailable: Version {{version}} is available. It downloads only when you choose to install it.
settings.updateDefault: Looks for a new version on GitHub once a day and tells you. Nothing is downloaded without your yes, and nothing else is sent.

notice.allDoneBody: Open ZeroConverter to see where they were saved.
notice.failedBody: Open ZeroConverter to see what went wrong and try again.

stillRunning.title: ZeroConverter is still running
stillRunning.body: Rename any file to a new format and it converts. Quit from the tray icon.

update.title: ZeroConverter {{version}} is available
update.body: Install it from Settings > About when it suits you.

rename.mismatchUnknownBack: {{name}} isn't really a {{expected}} file. The name was put back.

rename.sizePicturesBody: @ sets the largest side of an image in pixels. The name was changed back.

rename.folderTooBigBody: It holds more than {{max}} files. Convert smaller folders inside it.
rename.folderNothingLarge: Its files over 100 MB are skipped in a folder convert; rename them one by one. The folder name was changed back.
rename.folderNothingNone: No file in it can become {{format}}. The folder name was changed back.
rename.inBin: Original is in the Recycle Bin.
rename.notBinned: The original could not go to the Recycle Bin and stayed in the folder.

rename.originalsBin: Originals are in the Recycle Bin.

rename.notBinnedMany_other: {{count}} originals could not go to the Recycle Bin and stayed in the folder.

rename.folderNoFfmpeg: Left as they were because they need FFmpeg: {{count}}. Download it in the window that opened, then rename the folder again.
